import RNA, random, sys

target = ".(((.(((...(((.(((...))).(((....))).)))...(((.(((....))).(((...))).)))...(((.(((....))).(((...))).)))...))).(((...))).)))..".strip()
n = len(target)
assert n == 123

def get_pairs(s):
    stack=[]
    pairs={}
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c=='(':
            stack.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=stack.pop()
            pairs[j]=i

pairs = get_pairs(target)
paired_i = [i for i in pairs if pairs[i] > i]
unpaired = [i for i in range(n) if i not in pairs]

BP = [('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A'),('G','U'),('U','G')]
BASES = ['A','C','G','U']

fc_cache = {}

def fold(seq_str):
    fc = RNA.fold_compound(seq_str)
    struct, mfe = fc.mfe()
    return struct

def bp_distance(s1, s2):
    return sum(1 for a,b in zip(s1,s2) if a != b)

def random_seq():
    seq = [None]*n
    for i in paired_i:
        j = pairs[i]
        b1,b2 = random.choices(BP, weights=[0.35,0.35,0.12,0.12,0.03,0.03])[0]
        seq[i]=b1; seq[j]=b2
    for i in unpaired:
        seq[i] = random.choice(BASES)

    struct = fold(s)

    no_improve = 0

        if best_dist == 0:
            break
        # pick a position to mutate: bias towards mismatched columns
        mismatch_positions = [k for k in range(n) if struct[k] != target[k]]
        if not mismatch_positions or random.random() < 0.2:
            pos = random.randrange(n)
        else:
            pos = random.choice(mismatch_positions)

        if pos in pairs:
            i = pos if pos < pairs[pos] else pairs[pos]
            j = pairs[i]
            candidates = BP
            cur = (best_seq[i], best_seq[j])
            improved = False
            random.shuffle(candidates)
            for b1,b2 in candidates:
                if (b1,b2) == cur:
                    continue
                trial = best_seq[:]
                trial[i] = b1
                trial[j] = b2
                ts = ''.join(trial)
                tstruct = fold(ts)
                tdist = bp_distance(tstruct, target)
                if tdist <= best_dist:
                    if tdist < best_dist:
                        improved = True
                    best_seq = trial
                    best_dist = tdist
                    struct = tstruct
                    break
        else:
            cur = best_seq[pos]
            candidates = [b for b in BASES if b != cur]
            random.shuffle(candidates)
            improved = False
            for b in candidates:
                trial = best_seq[:]
                trial[pos] = b
                ts = ''.join(trial)
                tstruct = fold(ts)
                tdist = bp_distance(tstruct, target)
                if tdist <= best_dist:
                    if tdist < best_dist:
                        improved = True
                    best_seq = trial
                    best_dist = tdist
                    struct = tstruct
                    break
        if not improved:
            no_improve += 1
        else:
            no_improve = 0
        if no_improve > 300:
            break
    return best_seq, best_dist

random.seed(1)
global_best = None
global_best_dist = 999999
for restart in range(40):
    seq0 = random_seq()
    seq, dist = local_search(seq0, max_iters=1500)
    if dist < global_best_dist:
        global_best_dist = dist
        global_best = seq
        print("restart", restart, "dist", dist, ''.join(seq))
        sys.stdout.flush()
    if dist == 0:
        break

print("BEST_DIST", global_best_dist)
print(''.join(global_best))

import RNA

target = ".(((.(((...(((.(((...))).(((....))).)))...(((.(((....))).(((...))).)))...(((.(((....))).(((...))).)))...))).(((...))).)))..".strip()
n = len(target)
assert n == 123

def get_pairs(s):
    stack=[]
    pairs={}
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c=='(':
            stack.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=stack.pop()
            pairs[j]=i
            pairs[i]=j
    return pairs

pairs = get_pairs(target)

# identify stems: consecutive pairs (i,j),(i+1,j-1),...
pair_list = sorted([(i,j) for i,j in pairs.items() if i<j])
print(pair_list)

# group into stems (runs where i increases by 1 and j decreases by 1)
stems = []
used = set()
for i,j in pair_list:
    if i in used:
        continue
    stem = [(i,j)]
    used.add(i)
    ii, jj = i+1, j-1
    while (ii,jj) in pairs and pairs[ii]==jj and ii not in used:
        stem.append((ii,jj))
        used.add(ii)
        ii += 1
        jj -= 1
    stems.append(stem)

for s in stems:
    print(s)

# find hairpin loops: for each stem, check if the innermost pair's interior is all unpaired (a hairpin)
paired_set = set(pairs.keys())
hairpins = []
for s in stems:
    i_in, j_in = s[-1]  # innermost pair of the stem
    loop_positions = list(range(i_in+1, j_in))
    if all(p not in paired_set for p in loop_positions):
        hairpins.append((s, loop_positions))

for s, loop in hairpins:
    print("hairpin stem", s, "loop", loop, "len", len(loop))

import sys

lead = "A"*7
trail = "A"*7

def make_block(pairs29, loop1, loop2, conn2, conn14, conn3):
    # pairs29: dict local_index -> nucleotide, we'll build via list
    seq = ['']*29
    for (i,j,ni,nj) in pairs29:
        seq[i]=ni
        seq[j]=nj
    seq[2]=conn2
    seq[8]=loop1[0]; seq[9]=loop1[1]; seq[10]=loop1[2]; seq[11]=loop1[3]
    seq[14]=conn14
    seq[17]=loop2[0]; seq[18]=loop2[1]; seq[19]=loop2[2]
    seq[22]=conn3[0]; seq[23]=conn3[1]; seq[24]=conn3[2]
    return ''.join(seq)

pairs_common = [(0,28),(1,27),(3,26),(4,25),(6,13),(7,12),(15,21),(16,20)]

# Block A
pA = [(0,28,'G','C'),(1,27,'C','G'),(3,26,'G','C'),(4,25,'C','G'),
      (6,13,'G','C'),(7,12,'C','G'),(15,21,'G','C'),(16,20,'C','G')]
blockA = make_block(pA, "GAAA", "GAA", 'A', 'A', 'AAA')

# Block B - UUCG tetraloop, different connectors
pB = [(0,28,'C','G'),(1,27,'G','C'),(3,26,'C','G'),(4,25,'G','C'),
      (6,13,'C','G'),(7,12,'C','G'),(15,21,'C','G'),(16,20,'G','C')]
blockB = make_block(pB, "UUCG", "CAA", 'C', 'C', 'CCC')

# Block C - GCAA GNRA loop, different connectors
pC = [(0,28,'G','U'),(1,27,'C','G'),(3,26,'G','C'),(4,25,'C','G'),
      (6,13,'G','C'),(7,12,'C','G'),(15,21,'G','C'),(16,20,'C','G')]
blockC = make_block(pC, "GCAA", "UAA", 'G', 'G', 'GGG')

full = lead + blockA + "A" + blockB + "C" + blockC + trail
print(len(full))
print(full)
